geometry_bands.source_anchor: Permanent-transform chassis (R-M9 register): Mana-cost entry into the Rage-driven bear form with its own skill bar; kit maps IN-FORM per SB Rage-in-form law ('Mana is replaced by Rage while Transformed' -- verbatim).

Chance-proc quake under nearby enemies on melee hit, grounded on THREE legal fragments cited separately: skill_geometry 'Aftershocks appear under nearby enemies' + item_alterations 'Adorned Heorot Idols for Aftershock chance' + verify anchor 'Spam Swipe to deal damage and trigger Aftershocks'. [STEWARD AUDIT 2026-07-18: mapper's Title-Case 'affix/idol verbatim' ('Chance To Create An Aftershock Under A Nearby Enemy On Melee Attack') was an ANCHOR-SPLICE -- exists in NO store, memory-styled as tooltip text; STRUCK. Every mapped fact (under-enemy placement, chance-roll, on-melee trigger) is independently store-attested; geometry/trigger/grade unchanged.]
Berserker buff upkeep in the in-form loop; Rampage rides as movement utility (not a load-bearing damage active).

mapping.deviation_notes: Bear-form visual + Rampage traversal texture thinned; Earthquake-as-idol-scaler compressed into a delivery note; chance-roll proc kept as threshold trigger. In-form loop (melee arc spam + proc quakes + Rage pressure + DR stacking) survives intact -- that build.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: SB Rage-in-form law applied: in-form economy IS the kit economy; Mana->Rage swap recorded here, not as a second economy; permanent form dissolves the form-SWAP docket class (GX-02 not triggered; spirit-swap adjacency = design note only). Elements null/null per THE PHYSICAL RULE (corpus elem physical). T4 second door is BASE GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION per the cascade-pin: Aftershock is trigger-driven proc-geometry, neither on-kill (_cascade) nor on-hit scaling (_overkill) -> base token exactly as the pin directs. Variant-scoped attributes OFF core (7.2): Earthquake / Aftershock-named / Tornado / Shatter Totem / Cold DoT / BearSwarm variants (Shatter Totem noted as SB totem-lane texture; Cold DoT would implicate no-home LE Frostbite -- withheld). Earthquake spec mapped as scaler-not-skill per fetched note. Near-misses: stun (slam theme, never named -- 0-UNIVERSAL), chill (probe 'roar-slow' = probe-class, ILLEGAL).
mapping_json.motion_frame: enter permanent Werebear Form -> spam Swipe (chance-procs Aftershock quakes under nearby enemies) -> Warcry Berserker upkeep -> Rampage to reposition -> keep attacking so Rage never drains out
